description: Call this when the Professional asks where a Document Request stands: which documents arrived, which were approved or rejected, and when the Client was last chased. Give the request id when you have it, or a search term matching the title, the Client name or the Client email; several matches come back as a short list to choose from. One call returns the status, the checklist, every collected file with its verdict, and the reminder state, so no follow-up read is needed. Approving or rejecting a document is the decision of the Professional, made in the DokuTrak dashboard, and no tool here can take it.

request_id.description: The id of the Document Request, when known.

search.description: Text to match against the request title, the Client name or the Client email, when the id is not known.

name: get_request
title: Where does a Document Request stand
